title: Sable and the Wolf
author: W. M. Joubert
blurb: Marguerite Whitlock, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
